newsitem.title: AUSTRALIA: Campbell Bros plans to raise A$21 mln.
newsitem.headline: Campbell Bros plans to raise A$21 mln.

text.p: Industrial products and services provider Campbell Brothers Ltd said on Tuesday that it plans to raise around A$21 million through a one-for-four ordinary share issue priced at A$3.60 per share.
The issue would be used to repay debt following a series of acquisitions in the past year, including the Wolseley Castle consumer product business, the company said.

"Equity from the rights issue would be used to reduce borrowings raised for the recent acquisitions and will give the company the financial base to take advantage of future strategic opportunities in core business as they occur", managing director
Bruce Brown said in a statement.
The statement accompanied Cambell Brothers' full-year results, showing a net profit jump to a record A$7.44 million for the year ending on March 31 from A$4.31 million the previous year.
Brown said the company would continue to look for further opportunities in the core business areas - soap and chemicals, and laboratory services.

"We will be continuing to grow our position as one of the leading Australian owned manufacturers and distributors of cleaning products and technology and one of the largest independent analytical groups in the country," Brown said.
